description:
Develops web and desktop based solutions that deliver increased efficiency, timeliness, and quality gains.  
 -Experience with entire application life cycle, including the ability to assess opportunities and partner with staff to develop detailed application requirements. Excellent analytic, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.  
 -Ensures application documentation is correct and complete. Identifies solution options and negotiates with business leads in regards to functionality and delivery timeframes.  
 -Manages efforts to overcome obstacles and meet stated timeframes.  
 -Leads and contributes to programming and code development efforts.  
 -Partners with teammates, peer teams, and business contacts to identify improvement opportunities. Ensures high quality is at the forefront. 

 

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, typically six or more years of solid, diverse work experience in IT with a minimum of four years experience application program development, or the equivalent in education and work experience.  
 -Previous experience in the Education or Certification field preferred. 

 - "All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines". 
- All candidates who are authorized to work in US are encouraged to apply.
